RequestId.description: Correlation id echoed on every response, success or problem.

cursor.description: Opaque, tenant-bound continuation token from a previous `next_cursor`.
cursor.name: cursor

filterIssueOwner.description: Attribution filter over the read-only `owner` field. Never an authorization or tenancy input.
filterIssueOwner.name: issue_owner

filterSource.description: Logical source filter, validated server-side against the caller's enrolled sources.
filterSource.name: source

idempotencyKey.description: Caller-chosen idempotency identity. Required for every operation whose matrix row carries a non-`none` idempotency policy.
idempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key

lastEventId.description: SSE resume point. Streams also accept `cursor`; both resolve to the same sequence position.
lastEventId.name: Last-Event-ID

limit.description: Page size. Values above the server maximum clamp; they never error into an unbounded read.
limit.name: limit

Problem.description:
RFC 9457 problem document. Absent-versus-foreign is indistinguishable: a problem for
another tenant's resource is byte-equivalent to not-found. Upstream bytes are never
proxied into the problem.

BeadsBackend.description: One offerable substrate combination. The wizard axes (history, zone, residency, tenancy, pitr, deadline, offered tiers) are carried so a client renders exclusively from this list and can never offer a combination the create verb would refuse.

BeadsConnection.description: How to point a local bd at this project. Provisioning-only: there is deliberately no connector, connect or sync member, and none may be added back.

BeadsConnectionRecipe.description: Vendor-neutral local-bd onboarding. bd runs a configured credential command and authenticates with the short-lived token it prints.

BeadsEvent.description: Sequence-ordered project event. Dedupe key is (project_id, seq). Identical shape on history and stream.

issue.description: Full post-mutation issue. Null only for `delete`.

BeadsSizeTier.description: One row of the size catalog. Residency-independent, so it ships in full alongside every filtered backend page.

CityEvent.description: Durable city-ordered event. Historical and stream representations are identical.

payload.description: Bounded string map; optionally sensitive and withheld under the signed content policy.

ContentStatus.description: Sensitive content is omitted from metadata reads; `withheld` records that omission honestly.

ContributorSummary.description: Aggregate contributor context. Never a fabricated singular uploader.

CreateBeadsProjectRequest.description: The tenant is resolved from the caller's credential, never from this body: there is no org or workspace member, so a body cannot select a foreign tenant.

Inference.description: Inference metadata only. Prompt, completion, and transcript text are never duplicated here.

Issue.description:
The one closed issue DTO. Every operation returning an issue - list row, detail,
create, update, close, reopen, children, and the `issue` field of a Beads event -
returns this schema. `description` and `metadata` are populated on detail reads.

assignee.description: Attribution only. `null` is the unassigned facet token.

owner.description: Read-only attribution. Never writable and never an authorization or tenancy input.

IssueDependency.description: Canonical direction is containing issue to upstream target. Only `blocks` affects readiness.

IssueSource.description: Mode-stable aggregation context. One issue yields one source triple regardless of which operation returned it.

rig_name.description: Display attribution only; absent rather than fabricated from an id prefix.

Links.description: Tenant-bound relation map. A link is only mintable from a response the caller was authorized to read.

Metadata.description: Bounded string map. Keys prefixed `gc.` are system keys and stay plain entries.

PatchIssueRequest.description: Any subset of the drawer-editable fields; a debounced merge may send one field or all of them.

SessionTranscript.description: Rendered transcript for one session; a single sensitive-content read, not a paginated list.

content.description: Sensitive content. Omitted, with content_status withheld, unless the credential carries the content scope and the signed sensitive-content policy allows the read.

UpsertRunRequest.description: Natural-key upsert. Ownership, principal, and logical source are derived from the credential, never accepted here.

beadsBearer.description:
Bearer assertion issued for this deployment with `aud=beads`. Tenancy, principal
identity, and logical source are derived from the verified assertion; they are never
read from the request body, path, or query string. Query-string tokens are rejected.

info.description:
Every operation is snake_case on the wire, returns closed DTOs (no raw upstream
passthrough), reports failures as RFC 9457 problem documents carrying `request_id`,
and paginates through opaque tenant-bound cursors.
